notes.title: Pet Shop World Demo coming November 3rd 2023!
notes.notes: We are happy to announce the free Pet Shop World demo which we will be releasing on November 3rd! We initially didn’t even plan on releasing a demo, November 3rd was even planned as Early Access release date, but we decided its best to take things slowly, so you can have the best Early access experience possible and delayed its release to early 2024. The demo will feature most of the base game features except E-commerce and multiple stores. You will have a time limit ranging between 15 minutes and 1 hour. What does that mean you may ask? That basically means you initially have a 15 minutes gameplay limit per save, but if you send a personalised wishlist link generated in game to friends you get an extra 5 minutes for every friend that wishlists the game which than means you can expand the time limit to 1 hour if 9 of your friends wishlist the game with your link. 1 hour is the gameplay time limit per save in the demo.

notes.title: Devblog #1 - wrapping up pre-alpha development
notes.notes:
Most of the large and important game features have been implemented in the past 2.5 years and I recently pushed the possibly last large pre-alpha version 0.4.1 into testing which includes many new features and thanks to them I have finally made a video trailer for the game!
[previewyoutube=_WwaAfdz6Ms;full][/previewyoutube]
New features
The new features are:
-More decorations options - Now you can place lamps on ceilings and carpets on floors and we have implemented more plant options in the game
-I have made a working tutorial (The tutorial has went through so many iterations, I have lost count)
-Item info boxes - When building you have info such as description, price and size
-Nicer graphics in some areas
-Fixed some bugs
Here are some photos:

Future
I am still aiming for an early 2024 release. I plan on releasing a basic demo version by the end of this year, which will have some of the most basic features and will be polished as much as possible.

Thank you for reading! Please share this game as every wishlist means a lot and I really hope to make this the most realistic Pet Shop management game available
